Yellow front band 1.4 to 1.7 m (XML `light` clip).
Twin top lamps in their black oval housing on the roof cap.

Cream upper face and the corners' cream band, from the windscreens' sill (row 20) to the roof cap (row 8). Re-annotated: the earlier box (rows 8 to 10) took only the strip over the windscreens, which no longer is a separate visor part; the model's cap reaches the 3.3 m crown (row 7).
